title: SOME/IP: Improved robustness of UAT-based HFs
description:
Making sure that the dynamically generated HFs are regenerated on
changed UATs or profile change, even though SOME/IP is not bound to any
port.

Closes: #19670

notes.body:
These bugfixes were never cherry-picked to 4.2, so the bug got never closed. :disappointed: 

4.4 and master have the fixes already.

commits_data.title: SOME/IP: Improved robustness of UAT-based HFs (part 2)
commits_data.message:
SOME/IP: Improved robustness of UAT-based HFs (part 2)

This patch also makes sure that the HFs are recalculated, when UAT reset
CBs but not post_update CBs are called.
